about_the_game:
<GenesisScroll>is a classic RPG game that adopts a 3D perspective and leads players to experience an extraordinary world through rich plot stories.

The story originates from the "Galur Castle" and is presented to players in its entirety through a combination of third person narrative and first person dialogue. Players strengthen their strength through battles, missions, and various collections to obtain equipment, consumables, treasures, and more. They defeat various monsters to advance the plot and obtain higher rewards, as well as explore more unknown paths.

Gameplay: Story,Explore,Task,Talk, Level-Up,PVE, Equipment, Treasures, Abyss.

Duration: 24-48 hours

Number of people: single person, single machine.

The Ways to get rewards: By completing tasks or battles successfully, corresponding rewards will be obtained.

Battle mode: skills, treasures.

Monsters: Based on the plot, you can understand the background of each monster. They play different roles and positions in<GensisScroll>, and the skills they learn may be similar or unique. Remember to be carefully of them.

Abyss:Summon with scrolls, every party is a gathering of the strong.

short_description: The story takes place in a village near Galur Castle. When the lost scroll reappears in the world, he will uncover the story from a long time ago, follow the guidance of the scroll, continuously learn magic, enhance strength, and challenge the aura of the strong!
